python3 - <<'PYEOF'
import os
os.chdir('/Users/guillaumeloulier/PhpstormProjects/oss/elephc/.claude/worktrees/streams-csv-signature')
p='tests/codegen/io/streams.rs'
s=open(p).read()
old = '''            "6161616161616161616161613d0d0a616161616161616161\\n",
            // the escape FITS at column 6 with line-length 10, so no break precedes it
            "6161616161613d45393d0d0a626262626262\\n",
            // at line-length 8 it does not, so the break comes first and the triplet stays whole
            "61616161616161613d0d0a3d45396262623d0d0a626262\\n",'''
new = '''            "61616161616161616161613d0d0a616161616161616161\\n",
            // the escape FITS at column 6 with line-length 10, so no break precedes it
            "6161616161613d45393d0d0a626262626262\\n",
            // at line-length 8 the eighth `a` already needs one, and the triplet stays whole after
            "616161616161613d0d0a613d45396262623d0d0a626262\\n",'''
assert s.count(old)==1
s=s.replace(old,new)
s=s.replace('''            // 11 a's, the soft `=` that costs a column of its own, CRLF, then the remaining 9''',
            '''            // 11 a's, the soft `=` that costs the twelfth column, CRLF, then the remaining 9''')
open(p,'w').write(s)
print('expectation set from php')
